body:
Zach Hendricks (self-styled "Zaco") is a Fayette County contact (724 area code, two phone numbers in Google Contacts — one under "Zach," one under "Zack") who appears in the iMessage corpus with 58 messages across an eight-month window, March–November 2018. The timing places the contact squarely in the Fran caregiving and post-death period, and in the middle of the Annie relationship.
